title: Note required: what it does not apply to, and unusual cases
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with "Settings - Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  • Templates with the note option on and off, plus a template created before this release; you are filling inspections against them.
custom_steps:
1. With the option off, mark Monitor / Not OK with no note and Submit.
  2. Mark OK or N/A and Submit.
  3. Enter a note of only spaces on a flagged field.
  4. Write a note then change the response to OK.
  5. Open a pre-release template, then turn the option on mid-inspection.
  6. On an unlabelled field, read its outstanding-items row; and on a per-axle field with all positions OK but a stale flagged roll-up, check whether a note is required.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the option off, a Monitor or Not OK response with no note submits successfully.
  • An OK or N/A response never requires a note.
  • A note containing only spaces counts as empty.
  • Templates created before this release are unaffected until an author opens one and turns the option on.
  • Turning the option on while an inspection is already in progress leaves that inspection on the rule it started with.
  • A note written then abandoned (response changed to OK) is kept.
  • An unlabelled field is identified in the outstanding-items list by its type and position, not shown as an empty row.
  • A per-axle field whose positions all read OK requires no note, even if an axle carried a flagged roll-up from an earlier response shape.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9099 (S1 — Require a note on flagged responses); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S1; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1: “If the option is off, a Monitor or Not OK response with no note will submit successfully”
  • S1-N2: “If the response is OK or N/A, no note will be required”
  • S1-E1: “A note containing only spaces counts as empty”
  • S1-E2: “Templates created before this release are unaffected until an author opens one and turns the option on”
  • S1-E3: “If the option is turned on while an inspection is already in progress, that inspection keeps the rule it started with”
  • S1-E4: “If the technician writes a note and then changes the response to OK, the note is kept”
  • S1-E6: “If the field has no label, the outstanding-items list still identifies it by its type and position rather than showing an empty row”
  • S1-E7: “A per-axle field whose positions all read OK will not require a note, even if an axle carried a flagged roll-up from an earlier response shape”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
